subject: reasoning
question: Anuj starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 9 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Anuj starts from Point A and drives 5 km towards north.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 9 km.
 
• He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P
